name: Proxmox Backup Server (Open Source)
free_limit: GNU AGPLv3 backup server, free to download and use with incremental backups, deduplication, encryption and verification; no software-enforced client or backup storage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own server, disks, networking and maintenance. The no-subscription update repository is intended for testing/non-production and not recommended for production; enterprise updates and vendor support require a paid subscription. AGPLv3 obligations apply.
